extra_asset.windy.png: Kept in the icon set. Widgy Weather (Custom Images) / Symbol does not expose a dedicated Windy mapping slot in the verified working schema; use later as a conditional wind-speed override if desired.

notes: Cloudy Night intentionally reuses cloudy.png because the approved Home set has no separate overcast-night icon.
Rain Night and Showers Night intentionally share night_rain.png.
Night Snow and Night Fog reuse the same approved snow/fog artwork.
The HOME weather icon layer remains Weather (Custom Images) / Symbol, so Widgy selects the appropriate day/night slot automatically.
